name: xAI
summary: Formerly a standalone private AI company, xAI is now SpaceX's AI division, developing the Grok model family and AI infrastructure.
overview: This is a historical private-company profile. xAI became a wholly owned SpaceX subsidiary in February 2026; SpaceX completed its IPO in June 2026.

facts.label: Current status
facts.note: Formerly private: SpaceX acquired xAI on February 2, 2026, then completed its IPO in June 2026.

facts.label: X acquisition
facts.note: xAI acquired X in an all-stock transaction on March 28, 2025. Musk said X was valued at $45B including $12B of debt.

bull_case: Distribution through X and a large capital base can accelerate model iteration.
bear_case: Talent, compute costs, and model differentiation remain demanding challenges.
latest_round: Former private company; last standalone financing was January 2026: $20B Series E

intelligence.description: xAI was a standalone private AI company before becoming a wholly owned subsidiary of publicly traded SpaceX.
company: Founded by Elon Musk in 2023, xAI develops the Grok model family, with distribution through X and its own applications.
SpaceX acquired xAI on February 2, 2026, making it a wholly owned subsidiary. SpaceX completed its IPO in June 2026, so xAI should no longer be treated as a standalone private company.
intelligence.why_it_matters: xAI remains relevant to AI competition, but its economics and ownership now sit inside SpaceX. This profile preserves the private-company record; xAI is no longer a standalone private-company valuation comparable to the active private businesses in this directory.

changed.text: Acquired X for $33B of equity value in an all-stock transaction, combining the model business and social platform.
Raised a $20B Series E before the SpaceX transaction.
SpaceX acquired xAI, making it a wholly owned subsidiary.
SpaceX completed its IPO; xAI is now part of a public-company group.

takeaways: Grok benefits from a direct consumer distribution channel through X.
xAI is a former private company, now part of public SpaceX.
Compute spending and model performance remain central execution variables inside the SpaceX group.
